description: Any Solana account's data as named fields: an Anchor program's account decoded with the owner's on-chain IDL (the account type found by its discriminator), an SPL Token or Token-2022 mint or token account, an upgradeable program or its program data, a Squads v4 multisig, or a plain wallet. Says plainly when the owner publishes no IDL. Use for 'what's in this account?', 'decode this pool / vault / config', 'what are this market's parameters?'.
name: account_decode
title: Decode a Solana account
